  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis. (eado:pmid:39709737:recommendation-1)",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions. (eado:pmid:39709737:recommendation-1)",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation that the whole lesion should be excised with a narrow margin is 100 % (21 out of 21 experts). (eado:pmid:39709737:recommendation-1)",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness. (aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line)",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ. (aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line)",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness. (aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line)",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor. (aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-slnb-timing)",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as the wide excision whenever possible. (aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-slnb-timing)"
]
